name: o3k-brand
description: Machine-readable design tokens for the O3K visual identity. Source of truth for brand, semantic, surface, typography, icon-geometry, radii and stroke values. See brand/README.md for usage rules.

provenance.note: No documented canonical Kubedo palette was found (kubedo.io uses ad-hoc site CSS; no public brand repository). This palette was proposed for the O3K/Kubedo infrastructure family and is consistent with the colors already used in docs/architecture/*.svg. Araf currently uses Cloudscape-derived UI tokens (#0972d3 accent); Araf remains the human-interface identity and consumes this grammar via the icon set.

ink-900.role: wordmark on light surfaces, primary text

ink-700.role: substrate slot outlines on dark surfaces

blue-700.role: brand blue, high-emphasis text on light (contrast 6.7:1 on white)

blue-600.role: primary module fill on light surfaces (contrast 5.2:1 on white)

blue-500.role: primary module fill on dark surfaces (contrast 5.1:1 on ink-950)

cyan-500.role: signal/escape module on light surfaces — decorative only, never body text (contrast 2.4:1)

cyan-400.role: signal/escape module on dark surfaces (contrast 10.5:1 on ink-950)

cyan-700.role: cyan when used as text on light (contrast 5.4:1 on white)

cloud-50.role: primary text on dark surfaces (contrast 18.1:1 on ink-950)

slate-300.role: substrate slot outlines on light surfaces; secondary text on dark (12.7:1)

slate-500.role: muted text on light (contrast 4.8:1 on white)

rules.cyan-dominance: cyan is a signal accent only; it must never dominate a composition and never be used for body text
rules.status-not-brand: semantic colors never appear in the logo or brand marks

brand-wordmark.case: uppercase O3K in the graphic wordmark; O3K in prose
brand-wordmark.note: canonical wordmark SVGs ship as vector paths; no font installation required

rules: orthogonal/grid geometry first; diagonals only for arrows and connectors
no gradients, no shadows, no isometric 3D
filled cells mark active/owned state; outlined cells mark substrate; dashed cells mark in-transit or vacated capacity

mark.clear-space: one module cell (19 units) on all sides

spacing.note: logo module pitch (cell 19 + gap 7); illustrations reuse multiples of this rhythm
